item.text:
The switchover temperature is **35°F (about 1.7°C)**. Below that threshold, the natural gas furnace takes over heating from the heat pump.

The official *ResStock 2025 Release 1 Dual Fuel Heat Pump* documentation states: “For this measure upgrade, the switchover temperature is also set at 35°F.” See [Section 1.2.1.5, page 5](https://docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy26osti/96414.pdf#page=13).
